documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Approval Of The Un-Audited Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) Of The Company For The Second Quarter (Q2) And Half Year Ended September 30, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Stylam Industries Limited held its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call on July 24, 2026, reporting healthy margins and discussing operations. Management stated that commercial production for their new plant is expected to begin by September 1, 2026, with an anticipated revenue contribution of INR250 crores to INR300 crores in its first year. The company is actively restructuring its domestic business team and distribution network, expecting noticeable results from Q3 onwards. Furthermore, management noted that raw material prices and export demand remain stable, with the US tariff rate continuing at 10%. Stylam Industries reported its Q1 FY27 performance, recording a 15 percent increase in revenue compared to the same period last year and maintaining its zero-debt status.

guidance.claim: Management expects the new plant to achieve 30% plus capacity utilization in its first year.
guidance.quote: Plus, what we are looking at for the first year, maybe 20% to 30% plus capacity utilization for the new plant.

guidance.claim: The company expects the new plant to generate between INR250 crores and INR300 crores in revenue.
guidance.quote: I think based on the value of what you were saying, around INR250 crores to INR300 crores, it would be easily achieved from the third plant.

guidance.claim: Management expects similar margins of 19% to 20% plus even after the new capex starts.
guidance.quote: So, we can expect the similar kind of margins 19%, 20% plus.

guidance.claim: Stylam expressed confidence in achieving its financial guidance.
guidance.quote: Stylam is confident in achieving its financial guidance, indicating sustained momentum for growth.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve INR300 crores to INR400 crores turnover from the new plant in the next three quarters.
guidance.quote: But we are quite hopeful that we can get INR300 crores, INR400 crores turnover from this plant in the next 3 quarters.

guidance.claim: Management targets revenue of INR250 crores to INR300 crores from the new plant in the current financial year.
guidance.quote: For this financial year, I think we will target INR250 crores to INR300 crores from that particular plant.

guidance.claim: The company expects overall revenue growth of 20% to 25% for FY27 compared to the previous year.
guidance.quote: We cannot, it will be definitely 20%, 25% increase than the previous.

guidance.claim: Management projects revenue of INR600 crores to INR700 crores from the new plant at 80% utilization in the following year.
Management estimates peak utilization revenue from the new plant at INR900 crores to INR1,000 crores.
guidance.quote: I think we complete -- we can do around INR900 crores to INR1,000 crores from the new plant.

guidance.claim: The company expects the acrylic segment to achieve INR50 crores to INR70 crores this year.
guidance.quote: I think this year, we would be doing INR50 crores to INR60 crores, INR50 crores to INR70 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that Europe is performing well, along with positive momentum in the APAC region and Middle East.
demand_outlook.quote: In fact, for the entire world right now logistics is a very big problem, but that is a part of the business.

demand_outlook.claim: The US import tariff remains at 10%.
demand_outlook.quote: No, as of now it's 10%, but I think today morning it came a news that US is implementing because the 10% had to go 0% from 24th of July, which was today.

demand_outlook.claim: The rapid advancement in expansion highlights Stylam's commitment to enhancing production capacity and meeting increasing market demand.
demand_outlook.quote: The rapid advancement in expansion highlights Stylam's commitment to enhancing production capacity and meeting increasing market demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that demand remains robust and customers continue to buy despite price increases.
demand_outlook.quote: No, no. I think that doesn't matter if -- there is demand at all at the moment. Not only for us, for anyone. If there's a price increase, people will still keep on buying.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production of the new plant is scheduled to start by the first week of September.
capex_expansion.quote: Commercial production would be 1st of September, first week of September.

capex_expansion.claim: Dry run trials for the new plant are currently ongoing.
capex_expansion.quote: Dry run, dry run trial is already going on.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to announce a new capex after the current plant becomes operational by the end of August or early September.
capex_expansion.quote: So that is why, once plant is operated by end August, early September, definitely we will announce about our new capex.

capex_expansion.claim: Stylam is setting up a new state-of-the-art plant for manufacturing laminates adjoining its existing plant in Manak Tabra, Panchkula, Haryana.
capex_expansion.quote: Stylam is setting up a new state-of-the-art plant for the manufacturing of laminates, just adjoining to its existing plant in Manak Tabra, Panchkula, Haryana.

capex_expansion.claim: Stylam Industries is strengthening its leadership position with the commissioning of a new greenfield manufacturing facility, its third laminate plant.
capex_expansion.quote: Stylam Industries is strengthening its leadership position with commissioning of new green-field manufacturing facility, our third laminate plant, strategically located next to our existing facility at Manak Tabra in Panchkula, Haryana

capex_expansion.claim: The groundwork for the new plant is underway to enhance the ability to meet rising global demand.
capex_expansion.quote: The groundwork for the new plant is underway, enhancing our ability to meet rising global demand with greater speed and scale.

capex_expansion.claim: The construction of the new expansion plant is progressing well.
capex_expansion.quote: The construction of the new expansion plant is progressing well.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production of the third greenfield laminate plant in Manak Tabra is expected to start by the end of June or middle of July.
capex_expansion.quote: Hopefully it will be maximum middle of July, minimum end of June, it will start commercial production.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capex incurred for the new plant stands at INR334 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We have at this moment done the capex of INR334 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported no inventory gains contributing to the margin performance.
Phenol prices are approximately USD1,400 per ton and melamine is around USD1,000 to USD1,100.
margins_costs.quote: Right now, the phenol prices are approximately around USD1,400 per ton. Melamine is around USD1,000 to USD1,100.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that previous price hikes taken in the domestic market remain intact.
margins_costs.quote: As of now, yes. The raw material still remains the same condition. I think whatever price hike we have taken; it would remain intact.

margins_costs.claim: The company enhanced the share of value-added products in the product mix, expanded the product range, and improved net gross margins.
margins_costs.quote: Enhanced the share of value-added products in the product mix, expanded the product range, and improved net gross margins.

margins_costs.claim: The margin profile for the new plant is expected to be around 22% to 24%.
margins_costs.quote: It would be on the same pattern.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported a gross margin of 49% in the fourth quarter.
margins_costs.quote: I think it was 49% in the fourth quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Manufacturer price increases of 3% to 5% have already been implemented with customers.
margins_costs.quote: We already increased 3% to 5% to our customers, almost every manufacturer.

orders_capacity.claim: Management noted that the existing laminate plant has a slight efficiency gap of 5% to 10% remaining.
orders_capacity.quote: if we talk about laminate we still have a slight gap maybe 5-10% more, if we actually work on the efficiency more further.

orders_capacity.claim: Acrylic capacity is currently completely empty while domestic restructuring is underway.
orders_capacity.quote: Acrylic is completely empty right now, but we are as what we were discussing earlier that domestic we are revamping the entire team which acrylic is a part of it as well as exports.

orders_capacity.claim: Stylam operates one of the largest single location laminate manufacturing plants in Asia, spread across 80 acres with an annual capacity of 20 million sheets.
orders_capacity.quote: Stylam operates one of the largest single location laminate manufacturing plants in Asia, spread across 80 acres having an annual capacity of 20 million sheets.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved approximately 74% capacity utilization in the laminates division following modular expansions at existing facilities.
orders_capacity.quote: The company reached approximately 74% capacity utilization in the laminates division following modular expansions at existing facilities, increasing overall capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: Stylam sold 3.17 million sheets during Q1 FY27 compared to 3.27 million sheets in Q4 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Company has sold 3.17 Mn Sheets during the Q1 FY27 (Domestic - 1.10 Mn & Export 2.07 Mn) as compared to 3.27 Mn Sheets in Q4 FY26 (Domestic - 1.06 Mn & Export 2.21 Mn).

orders_capacity.claim: The laminate division achieved a 74% capacity utilization in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: the laminate division achieved a 74% capacity utilization in FY26.

capital_allocation.claim: Stylam became a net debt-free company and maintained this status, even after establishing a new plant.
capital_allocation.quote: Became a net debt-free company and maintained this status, even after establishing a new plant.

capital_allocation.claim: Stylam maintains its status as a zero-debt entity.
capital_allocation.quote: Stylam maintains its status as a zero-debt entity, reflecting strong financial health and effective capital management.

risks_headwinds.claim: Logistics currently presents a significant challenge globally, including for the Middle East market.
risks_headwinds.quote: In fact, for the entire world right now logistics is a very big problem, but that is a part of the business.

risks_headwinds.claim: Project delays occurred due to past family problems and rain in Chandigarh.
risks_headwinds.quote: And the delay was due to multiple reasons. I think due to our old family problem, I think we ourselves slowed down the project.

risks_headwinds.claim: Plant commissioning was delayed due to the requirement for environment clearance following a Supreme Court observation.
risks_headwinds.quote: Actually, in last year, maybe October, November, there was some Supreme Court observation in this area -- clarification, we need to have to meet EC, environment clearance.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that commercial production for the new plant will commence on September 1, 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Commercial production would be 1st of September, first week of September.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that results from domestic market restructuring will be visible from Quarter 3 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: And you will definitely see the results from Quarter 3. I won't even say Quarter 2, but you will see the results from Quarter 3 onwards.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve 80% plus capacity utilization of the new plant in the next 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: And that is why what we were saying that the ramp-ups definitely in the next 2 years, we will be able to achieve 80% plus capacity utilization of the new plant.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
